arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Suri argued the lower court nullified the Tobacco Control Act's venue restrictions.
Mr. Watson argued the Court lacks jurisdiction but should affirm the lower court's decision.
Justice Kagan suggested the statutory structure points opposite to the side that brought the case's interpretation.
Justice Kavanaugh asked if administrative law usually includes competitors as adversely affected parties.
